All installed files are static and part of the upstream source. The build process uses standard `install` commands to place files in the correct locations under `$pkgdir`, with no dynamic downloads, obfuscated code, or unexpected network activity.

There are no dangerous commands, eval usage, or remote code execution patterns. The systemd units are installed in the user directory, which is appropriate for user services. The package depends only on common Python libraries. No evidence of data exfiltration, backdoors, or unauthorized system modifications is present.
